test_paradigm: Rust, per .claude/rules/testing.md. Test files listed in files_to_modify are edited only by the acceptance designer, via the orchestrator; the crafter never edits acceptance bodies or markers.Every acceptance body is PRE-AUTHORED by DISTILL (distill/test-scenarios.md, distill/red-classification.md); crafters only remove the pending marker (#[should_panic] / #[ignore]), confirm the semantic RED, implement to the pinned contract (feature-delta.md Interface contracts), and confirm GREEN. Crafters never write, replace, weaken or complete an acceptance body, and never invent public API: a missing shape is a blocker surfaced to the orchestrator (CLAUDE.md 'Implement to the design'). Pure functions get proptest; DST invariants are seeded (seed printed); quint-connect conformance replays the in-place specs. Every command runs on metal (cargo xtask metal run -- ...), never Lima, never --exclusive for tests. Tests that need the volume-pool guest or a VMM carry kvm-tests on top of integration-tests. Marker retargets listed under 'Markers that move' in red-classification.md are test-file edits owned by the acceptance designer, performed by the orchestrator via nw-acceptance-designer at activation, not by the crafter. No roadmap step id or issue number in any new identifier, filename or log message (.claude/rules/domain-naming.md). Validator length warnings are cosmetic.

steps.name: A superseded launch ends cleanly: VmDriver observation points 1 to 6 and the shim's no-row StartSuperseded arm
steps.description: VmDriver::start observes the LaunchSupersession signal at points 1 to 6 (entry; after ensure, which is never interrupted; each claim poll and its sleep; after the claim wait and before the first host artifact; the guest-boot race; the second boot wait) and returns DriverError::StartSuperseded, tearing the VMM down where one exists and keeping the volume; superseded wins over a typed failure at the same point and a teardown failure stays StartRejected. The shim's start and restart arms handle StartSuperseded as a no-row success: release the lease, SVID and supervision claim, emit launch.superseded, and in the restart arm still run finish_restart. This is a component step that feeds 05-02: the signal has no producer until 05-02, where serve plus stop/restart close the loop through the production entry points. @sizing-review-needed (six observation points plus the shim arm; kept whole because the points share one signal contract and the shim arm has no other driver).
criteria: launch_supersession.rs: every pending test passes (points 1 to 6, the same-instant 'wins' tests, teardown failure is StartRejected, only its own launch is abandoned); the three guards keep passing
The five volume tests of points 2, 3 and 4 and a_volume_launch_whose_signal_is_never_raised... pass; a superseded volume launch creates nothing on the host before the claim wait ends

Every impl Driver and every exhaustive match on DriverError already carries StartSuperseded; a driver that ignores the signal behaves unchanged
